summary:
This week's Claude sessions skewed toward shipping infrastructure: scaffolding the dashboard you're reading right now, hardening the content schemas behind the rest of the site, and polishing the mobile chrome. Most of it was pairing on plans, then handing typed implementations off to subagents.

A few smaller threads ran in parallel — tuning the BLV AM8 print profile in `klipper-config`, prototyping an MCP server for shop-floor sensor data, and chasing a long-running deploy bug in an unrelated client project that turned out to be a missing `--build` flag.

highlights.oneLiner: Scaffolded the /dashboard page + Zod schemas Hermes will write to.
Designed the daily cron pipeline that powers this page.
